entities.summary: Teun Eikelboom better known as Tonny Eyk, a Dutch composer, arranger, pianist, bandleader, producer, entertainer, columnist and writer. He was also known for his appearances as a jury member in various television shows including Sterrenslag, Soundmixshow and Mini Playbackshow. His first book, Met Tonny Eyk naar de Provence, combines his love of the Tour de France and French gastronomy. Eyk was also an ambassador of the Dutch company Princess Household Appliances. He graduated by majoring in trombone at the Royal Conservatory in The Hague.
